Infraction classification and application

         1.​Definition
                                                               ​
           If we read the current rules, if a fighter enters the list with equipment (armor, shield, or weapon)
           that fails the authenticity check, he/she receives a green card the fighter enters the list but only
           once per tournament.

           Authenticity Committee think this rule is too punishing as we understand some fighters are not
           supported by any authenticity committee members, or have difficulties to purchase armor that
           match aesthetic standards of Buhurt International. Therefore, we would like to propose both
           clarification and softening of how authenticity rules are applied.

           Authenticity rules are meant to be followed by all competitors attending Buhurt International
           tournaments, no matter the category. If a competitor shows up with an armor, shield or weapon that
           does not comply with the Authenticity rules, he/she risks a penalty.

         2.​Infraction classification
           During Authenticity Check, Authenticity officers will evaluate the entire equipment of competitors
           before the start of the tournament. Any violation of the Authenticity rules will result in an infraction.
           Infractions can be classified under 3 different levels:

             2.1.​Minor infraction
                  It is a small detail not easy to see, and it does not affect the coherence of the whole armor
                  (small traces of rust, hammering marks, little datation difference between 2 parts etc.).​

             2.2.​Moderate Infraction
                  It is something forbidden by the Authenticity rules (i.e badly designed helmet, over numerous
                  eye bars etc.). Not respecting the rules can't be accepted, thus it is not severe enough to
                  prevent the fighter from entering the list.​

             2.3.​Major infraction
                  Fantasy armor or totally inaccurate equipment, that prevent the fighter from entering the list
                  and damage the image of the sport, the teams and Buhurt International.​




Infraction classification and application                                                    3

3.​Application of the rules

         ●​ A violation of the authenticity rules will result in a green card. Depending on the rank of
            tournament, infraction will be applied differently.​

         ●​ A green card combined with a yellow card will result in a red card and the competitor will be
            disqualified from the tournament.

         ●​ A competitor can receive only 1 green card per tournament, no matter how many infractions they
            have.

            3.1.​Source
                 No authenticity check required.​
                 Authenticity members on site will be able to give advice and guidance.

            3.2.​Classic
                 Authenticity check is mandatory prior to the start of the tournament. ​
                 A competitor is allowed to enter the list if they respects the following cumulative criterias.
                      ●​ Have no more than 3 minors infraction (if they have 4 or more, they will receive a
                          green card).
                      ●​ Have no more than 1 moderate infraction (if they have 2 or more, they will receive a
                          green card.
                      ●​ Have no major infraction.

            3.3.​Regional
                 Authenticity check is mandatory prior to the start of the tournament.
                 A competitor is allowed to enter the list if they respects the following cumulative criterias.
                      ●​ Have no more than 2 minors infraction, if you have 3 or more, then they will receive
                          a green card.
                      ●​ Have no moderate infraction. If they have 1 or more, they will receive a green card.
                      ●​ Have no major infraction.

            3.4.​Conference
                 Authenticity check is mandatory prior to the start of the tournament.
                 A competitor is allowed to enter the list if they respects the following cumulative criterias.
                      ●​ Have no more than 1 minor infraction, if you have 2 or more, then they will receive a
                          green card.
                      ●​ Have no moderate infraction.
                      ●​ Have no major infraction.

                Note: as an exceptional measure, for season 2025, tournaments of Conference level will be
                considered as Regional regarding Authenticity rules. It means a competitor with 1 moderate
                infraction will be allowed to fight, but will receive a green card.
